en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Yahya Bin Habeeb Al Zayyat who said,

‘He informed me, the one who was seated in the presence of Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, that when they (people) arose (to leave the gathering), he<sup>asws</sup> said to them: ‘Meet Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, so greet upon him<sup>asws</sup> and renew the Covenant with him<sup>asws</sup>’.
So when the people left, he<sup>asws</sup> turned towards me and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be Merciful to Al-Mufazzal, he was content without this’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yahya ibn Habib al-Zayyat who has said the following.

“A man who was present in a meeting (of people) with abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.) spoke to me of the information herein below. “When people readied themselves to leave the meeting the Imam (a.s.) said to them, “Meet abu Ja‘far (a.s.), (before you leave), offer to him greeting and renew your covenant with him.”
When left, he (the Imam) said to me, “May Allah grant well-being to al-Mufaddal, he would have believed (in the succeeding Imam) without it (the command to renew their covenant)”.
